name: Inkling
description: Thinking Machines Lab's 952B MoE multimodal model (InklingForConditionalGeneration): 66 layers in a [5 × sliding-window (512), 1 × global] pattern with no RoPE — positions come from a learned, content-dependent relative bias — causal short-convs on K, V, attention and MLP outputs, 256 routed experts (top-6 + 2 shared, ~40B active), a muP-scaled untied head, an 8-layer MTP draft chain, and small vision and audio encoders. Numbers from config.json and the safetensors headers.

summary.note: Every tensor in the checkpoint (incl. MTP / draft and vision weights), summed from the safetensors headers. The README states "975B total, 41B active" with no breakdown, so the ~23B (total) / ~1.2B (active) gap is not explained by the card; our figures are exact tensor sums.

Weights multiplied per text token by the main model: lm head included; embedding (a row lookup), MTP / draft heads and vision / audio encoders excluded. The README states "975B total, 41B active" with no breakdown, so the ~23B (total) / ~1.2B (active) gap is not explained by the card; our figures are exact tensor sums.

summary.value: SWA-512 5 : 1 global, no RoPE (learned relative bias), 64 q / 16 kv (sliding) · 64 q / 8 kv (global), head 128
